title: Table Games Reborn
description: An updated and expanded continuation of Table Games for Minecraft Java 1.21.11, with bug fixes, rebalanced chip crafting, and new poker buttons.
body:
**Table Games Reborn** is an updated continuation of the original [**Table Games**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/table-games) datapack by **2M3V**, adapted for **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11**.

The original datapack stopped being updated after version **1.20.4**, so I restored compatibility with **Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11**, fixed a number of bugs, prepared the project for future development, rebalanced poker chip crafting, and added new poker buttons. This release was made with permission from the original datapack author.

This version adds two new types of poker chips **CH** and **AR** with a **rebalanced crafting system**.

> **⚠️ INSTALLATION:**
> This ZIP works as both a **datapack** and a **resource pack**.
>
> Put the **same ZIP file** into both the **datapacks** and **resourcepacks** folders, then enable it as a resource pack in the game and run `/reload`.


<details>
<summary>✨ Changes and Improvements</summary>

> ### **New Items and Recipes**
>
> - Added three separate poker buttons: **Dealer (D)**, **Small Blind (SB)**, and **Big Blind (BB)**.
>
> - Added two new poker chip types, **CH** and **AR**, with a rebalanced crafting system.

> ### **Gameplay Improvements**
>
> - Poker chips can now stack in the inventory up to **64 items per slot**.
>
> - Added a more convenient way to pick up poker chips from stacks when already holding the same chip.
>
> - The chess board can now also be placed on **Pale Moss Carpet**.

> ### **Bug Fixes**
>
> - Placed items now work correctly in **Creative mode** when picked up.  
> They no longer disappear or turn into a stone button.
>
> - Chess pieces can no longer be placed inside each other on the same square.
>
> - The Chips Exchanger has been improved to prevent items from being placed into unintended slots.

> ### **Localization**
>
> - Item translations have been revised and improved.
>
> - Added **Spanish** localization.

</details>


<details>
<summary>🔶 Crafting Recipes</summary>

> ### **Cards Bundle**
>
> Contains **54 cards**. When used, it gives the player a random card.  
> If the bundle is in the **off hand** and a card is in the **main hand**, using it will put the card back into the bundle.
>
> If the bundle is dropped onto the table, after **2 seconds** it will automatically collect nearby cards within a **1-block radius**, as long as there is enough space inside.
>
> If used **while sneaking** and looking at a block, the bundle is placed as an item.  
> If used **while sneaking** and looking into the air, it gives the player a hidden card.
>
> Placed cards can be flipped by interacting with them **while sneaking**.
>
>![Мешок с картами](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7f31de04a9f7827ca74274e94869459a0111f10.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Chess Bundle**
>
> Contains **32 chess pieces**.  
> If the bundle is in the **off hand** and a chess piece is in the **main hand**, using it will put the piece back into the bundle.
>
> If the bundle is dropped onto the table, after **2 seconds** it will automatically collect nearby chess pieces within a **1-block radius**, as long as there is enough space inside.
>
> Chess pieces are placed on a **grid** that matches the squares of the chessboard.  
> If used **while sneaking**, the bundle is placed as an item.
>
>![Мешок с шахматами](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ac2cd132e71447b5581a9982d26e73dadb8bf72.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Checkers Bundle**
>
> Contains **24 checker pieces**.  
> If the bundle is in the **off hand** and a checker piece is in the **main hand**, using it will put the piece back into the bundle.
>
> If the bundle is dropped onto the table, after **2 seconds** it will automatically collect nearby checker pieces within a **1-block radius**, as long as there is enough space inside.
>
> Like chess pieces, checker pieces are placed on a **grid** that matches the squares of the board.  
> If used **while sneaking**, the bundle is placed as an item.
>
>![Мешок с шашками](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bacf90c29c76015c2433488e6d06212e0698deb.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Domino Bundle**
>
> Contains **24 domino tiles**.  
> If the bundle is in the **off hand** and a domino tile is in the **main hand**, using it will put the tile back into the bundle.
>
> If the bundle is dropped onto the table, after **2 seconds** it will automatically collect nearby domino tiles within a **1-block radius**, as long as there is enough space inside.
>
> If you interact with a domino tile **while sneaking**, it rotates by **90°**.
>
> If used **while sneaking**, the bundle is placed as an item.
>
>![Мешок с домино](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae3591e3c5044a118f4930c20ca459ab3976fee9.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Chess Board**
>
> The chess board is placed on a **2×2 block surface** covered with **any carpet**.
>
> ![Шахматная доска](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a1041e92016c7d4c4b6bdb5350584bff6244796.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Dice**
>
> When placed, it rolls a random value **from 1 to 6**.
>
> ![Игральный кубик](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c20107a24ad75f5f97f657e453a874d6a87a739.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Poker Chips**
>
> Chips are placed on a grid and can be **stacked on top of each other**.
>
> You can pick up chips from a stack with an **empty hand** by interacting with them.
>
> If you already have the **same chip** in your main hand, you can pick up one chip directly into that slot by interacting with a chip stack **while sneaking**.  
> This makes it easier to collect chips from stacks without manually reorganizing your inventory.
>
> ![Покерные фишки](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/328c0c5314172920b501e539ae780ec06dbc2a03.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Chips Bundle**
>
> Used to store poker chips.  
> If you add a **dye** to the recipe, the bundle texture will match the dye color.   
>
> ![Мешок с фишками](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c79c3a7062b3510c6b01c61cfc59417875068eb.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **Chips Exchanger**
>
> Allows you to exchange chips back into resources.  
>
> ![Обменник фишек](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b14faafbba781aab57dfb6a0e19e0260b95fce1.png)  
  
  
>
> ### **NEW: Poker Buttons**
>
> Three separate poker buttons have been added: **Dealer (D)**, **Small Blind (SB)**, and **Big Blind (BB)**.  
> They use the same gameplay behavior as poker chips: they are placed on a grid and can be **stacked on top of each other**.  
> Unlike regular chips, **the Chips Exchanger does not interact with them**.
>
> ![Покерные кнопки](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95ce8c63d825da3f74d3e5b08a41e0a836496636.png)  
</details>


<details>
<summary>🟦 Poker Chip Crafting System</summary>

### **CH Chips**

These are simpler chips intended for regular gameplay. They are a good fit if you just want to play poker with friends on a server where plugins cannot be installed.

The crafting pattern is classic: **one item in the center + 4 Gold Nuggets in a cross shape**, but the center item has been changed.
 
| Center item | Result |
|---|---|
| Sugar | **1 CH** |
| Redstone Dust | **5 CH** |
| Lapis Lazuli | **10 CH** |
| Emerald | **25 CH** |
| Gold Ingot | **50 CH** |
| Amethyst Shard | **100 CH** |  

![CH-фишки](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00d0d09b88493b0e8ef24410a6e931961cd35316.png)
  
  

### **AR Chips**  

These are higher-value chips with a distinct appearance. They are crafted using **Deepslate Diamond Ore**.

Visually, they are different from CH chips: **they have a dot in the center**, making them easier to tell apart.  
Each chip also has its value shown in its name, so players do not get confused.

### How AR Chip Crafting Works

AR chip crafting works differently from regular crafting:

- the main item is placed in the **center slot**  
  (**Sugar / Redstone Dust / Lapis Lazuli / Emerald / Gold Ingot / Amethyst Shard**)
- one **Deepslate Diamond Ore** is placed in the **right slot**
- the remaining required **Deepslate Diamond Ore** is automatically removed from the player’s inventory when the result is taken  

| Center item | Item in the right slot | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Sugar | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **1 AR** |
| Redstone Dust | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **3 AR** |
| Lapis Lazuli | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **6 AR** |
| Emerald | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **16 AR** |
| Gold Ingot | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **32 AR** |
| Amethyst Shard | Deepslate Diamond Ore | **64 AR** |

![AR-фишки](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de70062db9e49405ae20d761835869616ba21218.png)

**_Example:_**  
You want to craft a **16 AR chip**. You already have the required amount of **Deepslate Diamond Ore** in your inventory.  
Place an **Emerald in the center** and **one Deepslate Diamond Ore in the right slot**, then take the result from the crafting output. The datapack will automatically remove the remaining **15 Deepslate Diamond Ore** from your inventory.  
If you do not have enough **Deepslate Diamond Ore**, the recipe will not work.

</details>
